# zswap-memo-companion frozen vectors -- AnchorV1 (spec "AnchorV1
# logical and field layout"; plan 00003 Phase 1 task 3).
#
# Format and provenance: see vectors/README.md.
#
# DO NOT hand-edit. Regenerate with:
#   cargo run --bin gen_vectors
#
#   c       = EmbeddedGroupAffine::generator()
#   ciph[0] = Fr::from_le_bytes("midnight:zswap-anchor")   # marker
#   ciph[1] = Fr::from(1)                                  # version
#   ciph[2] = Fr::from_le_bytes(N_bytes[31..32])           # trailing byte FIRST
#   ciph[3] = Fr::from_le_bytes(N_bytes[0..31])            # leading 31 bytes
#   ciph[4] = h                                            # nonzero
#   ciph[5] = Fr::from(0)                                  # reserved
#
# `untagged` is THE FORM THAT APPEARS ON THE WIRE (Phase 0 finding
# F-0.10): inside a serialized transaction a CoinCiphertext carries no
# tag header of its own. `tagged` is the standalone-artifact form and is
# pinned only so the difference is unmistakable. An anchor scanner must
# match `untagged`.
#
# Note also that `untagged_len` VARIES between records: each Fr is
# serialized as a SCALE-compact variable-length integer, so an anchor has
# no fixed width. A scanner must not assume one.
